prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone original portrait-source candidate for a game's square and circular character UI.
Input image 1: the project's approved original Ancient Leshen miniature design; use it as the sole identity, head silhouette, antler branching, material and palette reference. Transform its presentation into one head-and-shoulders painted portrait.
Primary request: Paint the same ancient woodland creature centered and front facing: narrow weathered ivory deer skull with deep dark hollow eye sockets, long nasal opening and elongated muzzle; very large paired branching brown stag antlers with lighter worn tips; gnarled interwoven bark neck and shoulders with muted moss patches. Preserve the skull shape and distinctive wide, many-tined antler crown of the reference. Include only the small black raven perched on the image-right shoulder as visible in that reference, kept secondary and fully inside the composition.
Scene/backdrop: plain opaque charcoal, subtly painted, no scenery.
Style/medium: project's matte hand-painted miniature craft translated into an original painted character portrait; controlled brush strokes, readable sculpted planes, dry bark texture, matte old bone and sparse soft moss, restrained edge highlights.
Composition/framing: square 1024x1024 image; whole antler crown and every tip visible, entire skull and both shoulders visible. Use a generous bust framing, not a tight face crop: antler crown in the upper half, skull centered just below it, upper chest below. Keep ALL antlers, skull, and the shoulder raven inside a centered circular safe area of radius 43% of image width, with at least 8% empty margin from the square edges and extra room at upper corners. Never cut off an antler tip. Leave quiet charcoal negative space around the silhouette. The lower chest may softly fade into the backdrop.
Lighting/mood: soft warm key with subdued cool fill, ancient stillness; separate brown antlers and bark from charcoal.
Color palette: weathered ivory bone, warm earth-brown antlers and bark, desaturated forest-green moss, charcoal-black raven and backdrop. Preserve the reference's natural matte palette.
Constraints: one creature only; no human face, no glowing eyes, no extra horns, no foliage crown, no flames, no weapon, no hands, no base, no text, no frame, no logo, no watermark. Preserve full antler silhouette. Do not recreate a full-body miniature product shot or a contact sheet. Only the painted bust portrait.
